prompt: Which high school did the former Archbishop of Cape Town, Njongonkulu Winston Hugh Ndungane, attend when he completed his schooling in December 1958?
answer: Njongonkulu Winston Hugh Ndungane attended **Lovedale High School in Alice, Eastern Cape**, completing his schooling there in December 1958.
